VcuDmaTxRecord.description: One record of the DMA1 channel 7 transmit queue: a 32-bit length word (low 16 bits used by the DMA start) and a payload area. The payload area is 252 bytes, but the enqueue accepts at most 242 bytes.

fields.name: len
fields.description: Payload length in bytes; passed to the DMA count register by vcu_dma_tx_start.

fields.name: len_hi
fields.description: Upper half of the 32-bit length word written by FUN_08008bb0; not used by the DMA start.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Payload bytes (the frame) copied to the DMA memory address by vcu_dma_tx_start.
